title: Follow multiple Dexcom G6s?
body:
I have a situation where I have three kids and each wears a Dexcom G6.  Each child has their own Android device, is collecting its own data through XDrip+, and uploading to their individual Nightscout websites.  
Is there a way to use XDrip+ to follow all three data feeds simultaneously on my Android phone?
Thanks,
Greg

comments.body: I don't know about XDrip but could use the Dexcom Share (through XDrip) and the official Dexcom Follow app to achieve this.

@DrSolarMOTA - I'm in a similar situation.  Both my son and I wear G6s and have phones running xDrip, uploading to separate Nightscouts, etc.

My phone runs xDrip for me, and then I used an app call [AppCloner](https://appcloner.app/) to clone the APK and install it as a follower.  Works fine.

I don't know if you can run multiple app instances as followers because of how xDrip uses google cloud messaging is used for sync - the pro version of AppCloner has an override for that which may be the ticket.

We've been running this way for a few years and it's worked great.

Pixel 2, Android 10 for my phone, Nexus 5X, Lineage 15.1 for his, FYI.

@DrSolarMOTA - good point - if you just sync off Nightscout then there should be no issues. I have my phone as a follower so that I can enter treatments, etc directly through xDrip (which syncs to the master, then uploads to Nightscout), so that's the direction I was coming from.

I would suggest using one of the xDrip variants. This is what we do here. Pro-tip change the flair colors to something different so you can tell them apart on your phone!

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/267#issuecomment-371077145
@jamorham - Thank you!!  I knew that I couldn't be the first person in this situation and that there had to be a workaround already in place.
